name: 14411 · Albion, NY
findings: ZIP 14411 (Albion) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14411 (Albion) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
63% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14411 (Albion) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
